title: HookContext
description: The file onefollowup writes for one run of a hook whose argv names `{context_file}`, and removes once the hook exits. It is an instance of onepipeline 0.110.2's `PhaseContext` (`schemas/human-items.schema.json`, read by `human-items raise --phase P --context FILE`), whose reader refuses any member it does not know: `owner` is that release's `HumanItemOwner` and each ticket its `Ticket` as `{id, url, priority}`, both copied as it states them.

owner.description: Who owns what the hook raises: `hooks.owner`, each `${NAME}` read from the verb's environment.

dedup_key.description: `<namespace>.follow-up/<batch>/<hook>`: the same every time the batch runs the hook.

tickets.description: One per ticket the batch's receipts say it created or updated, in the order the journal first names each.

vars.description: The hook's stdin document but for its `schema_version`, each member as text: a string as itself, any other scalar as its JSON spelling, a list or mapping as compact JSON.

HumanItemOwner.description: The originating session and optional run and plan.

Ticket.description: One ticket a review phase aggregates.

url.description: Where a person opens it: the URL its source states, else a `file://` URL of the file a source keeps it in, else its id.

priority.description: Its priority as the store holds it, `none` when it has no usable one.
